Class KeyboardController

java.lang.Object
gamemode.lobby.logic.KeyboardController
public class KeyboardController extends Object
The KeyboardController class handles keyboard input for the lobby game mode.

It listens to key press and key release events from a JavaFX Scene and maintains the current pressed state of specific keys:

  • W - Move Up
  • S - Move Down
  • A - Move Left
  • D - Move Right
  • P - Custom action (e.g., Pause / Pushup / etc.)
  • F - Custom interaction key

This class only tracks input states and does not perform any game logic. The game loop should query the boolean getters to determine player actions.
